notes: Extracted from the raw HTML of the official help-center article: three tables (Wren, Markus, Chieftain) with columns Title | Requires | Wood | Clay | Iron | Crop | Other. Source order preserved.
The article itself warns the list may differ slightly from what a player sees in-game.

The Requires column mixes prerequisite quests and role markers ("King"/"Governor"); markers mapped to `role`, quest names to `requires` ids. Short names in Requires ("5 units", "Build Residence", "Residence level 5", "Embassy", "Train 3 Settlers", "All croplands to 7") were resolved to the matching quest ids.

Tribe-specific rows ("N units - Romans/Gauls/Teutons", "Train 3 Settlers - <tribe>") were merged into one quest each with reward.rt. Tribe-specific scout quests (Equites Legati / Pathfinder / Scout) have different names, so they stay separate quests with an extra `tribe` field.
Empty or "/" resource cells stored as 0. Non-resource rewards (XP, gold, culture points, adventure points, silver, card items, building upgrades) are in reward.other verbatim.

Missing rows: "Collect 3 Tributes" (prerequisite of "Collect 10 tributes") and "Sell 300 stolen goods" (prerequisite of "Sell 1000 stolen goods"). Added with reward null; their prerequisites and positions are inferred.
"Collect 300 tributes" lacks the King marker; role set to king by analogy.
"Sell a stolen good" reward reads "35 SP" (all other stolen-goods quests give XP) - possibly a typo.
The prose mentions a King-only quest "Build a Treasury", but no such row exists in any table; it was NOT added (giver, reward and prerequisites unknown) - TODO verify in-game.
Quests can be done in any order, rewards can be claimed later, and quests whose condition is already met appear pre-completed.
Rewards go to the currently active village; building-upgrade rewards need the building there (Warehouse 10-11 -> 12, Residence/Palace 5-9 -> 10).
Task texts are paraphrases. "Fields/Croplands to 10 in 5/12" interpreted as "in 5/12 villages" - assumption. "Croplands to level 1" may mean one or all croplands - ambiguous.

items.info: Quest book (exclamation-mark icon on the left of the village view), tab "Daily quests".
The book has 3 slots, so at most 3 daily quests can be held at once.
Claiming a reward empties the slot; a new quest arrives after a short delay shown by a countdown.
An unwanted quest can be swapped for another via the exchange icon.

notes: The official article lists no concrete daily tasks, points or reward values - only the mechanics above. Task/reward data is unknown (TODO).
